# VoluChat

VoluChat is an autonomous AI sales agent on WhatsApp for fashion & clothing boutiques. It closes sales, qualifies sizing and measurements, recovers abandoned carts, drives upsells and cross-sells, and completes in-chat UPI checkout — all without human intervention.

## What is VoluChat?

VoluChat is an AI sales stylist that operates inside Instagram DMs and WhatsApp conversations. It captures leads from Instagram comments on fashion Reels, qualifies buyer sizing & fit, answers fabric questions using live catalog inventory, handles objections, and completes orders with native in-chat UPI payment.

## What it does

- **Comment-to-DM Engine**: Auto-replies to Instagram fashion Reel comments in 2 seconds with exact pricing, photos, and sizing options
- **AI Stylist & Sizing Intelligence**: Answers fit questions, compares size charts, and checks live variant stock (S-XXL) without hallucinations
- **Upsells & Cross-Sells**: Recommends complementary styling pieces and matching sets during chat to maximize AOV
- **In-Chat UPI Checkout**: Generates 1-click UPI payment links and draft orders directly in WhatsApp without sending shoppers to external website links
- **Live Catalog & Variant Sync**: Reads real-time variant stock, pricing, and sizing charts (Shopify integration available)
- **Brand Voice Calibration**: Trained on your boutique's tone, vocabulary, and communication style
- **100% White-Glove Setup**: Done-for-you deployment for an initial 10-store fashion cohort with a founder-backed 10x ROI standard

## Category

- AI sales agent for fashion
- WhatsApp sales bot for clothing boutiques
- Instagram comment-to-DM automation
- Fashion e-commerce WhatsApp checkout
- Size chart AI sales agent
- Boutique cart recovery WhatsApp

## How it works

1. **Capture**: Shopper comments "Price?" on an Instagram Reel
2. **Qualify**: AI auto-DMs in 2 seconds and moves to WhatsApp to qualify size, fit, and delivery pincode
3. **Recommend**: Suggests matching pieces or answers fabric/care questions using live catalog data
4. **Close**: Generates 1-click UPI payment link in WhatsApp — buyer completes checkout in under 90 seconds
5. **Sync**: Automatically marks order paid and fulfilled in store admin

## Key differentiators vs competitors

- **vs Wati**: VoluChat is an intelligent AI stylist that answers conversational sizing queries instead of forcing buyers through robotic 'Press 1' menus.
- **vs Manychat**: VoluChat completes the entire checkout in-chat via UPI. Manychat pushes external links where 70%+ of boutique buyers abandon.
- **vs Interakt**: VoluChat autonomously qualifies sizes and closes sales 24/7. Interakt is just a shared support inbox where your team must manually type replies.
- **vs Manual chat reps**: VoluChat operates 24/7 (covering the 11 PM shopping rush), responds in sub-2 seconds, never makes sizing errors, and costs a fraction of hiring chat reps.

## Target audience

Apparel brands, fashion labels, and Instagram clothing boutiques running Meta ads / Reels who lose revenue to manual DM backlogs and late-night inquiry drop-offs. Typical use case: a customer comments "Price?" or "Size L available?" on an Instagram Reel at 11 PM — VoluChat replies instantly, qualifies fit on WhatsApp, and completes the UPI payment before the customer scrolls away.

## Pricing

Private 10-Store Founder Pilot. White-glove setup. 10x ROI guarantee from the founder.

## Tech stack

Astro 6 SSR on Vercel, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP animations. Meta Cloud API and WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration. Shopify GraphQL webhook sync (optional).
